messages:
lucas: Heads up — saw a spike in 503s coming from eu-west on /v1/generate at 15:08 PDT. Latency + error rate both up. Routing fallback kicked to quant-small. Starting a quick war-room. Bridge: https://meet.redwood.com/warp/4f7b
ops-bot: automatic-reroute executed for customer-tier=hosted at 15:09 PDT — fallback model: gptx-quant-small, reason: capacity pressure
maya: joining the bridge now, will pull logs. I can check routing logs and kv-cache pressure first.
devon: on mobile, but can join in 2m. Any quick mitigations we want while we triage?
lucas: main ask: confirm whether fallback is correct and if quality/regressions are being observed. Also want to know if this is capacity-only or a broader perf regression.
maya: looking at nginx metrics: 5xx spike aligns with increased queue time on gateway -> `proxy_read_timeout` spikes. Posting a snippet of the recent tail: ```
2026-03-16T15:08:51Z gateway[svc-1] WARN request timeout route=/v1/generate id=...
2026-03-16T15:08:52Z gateway[svc-1] ERROR upstream 504 model-node-17
```
trisha: I can check model-nodes and GPU telemetry — ping me if you want me to run a rebalance.
nate: if kv-cache evictions are high, that can blow up token generation times. Maya, can you paste eviction metrics?
maya: eviction rate jumped ~3x starting 15:06. Query: `sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m])) by (pod)` shows node 17 and 18 highest.
devon: joining bridge now. On bridge: https://meet.redwood.com/warp/4f7b
lucas: agenda for this ad-hoc: 1) confirm root cause (capacity vs network vs model OOM), 2) temporary mitigation (route to dedicated pool or increase timeout), 3) owner for follow-up postmortem.
trisha: I can temporarily exclude node-17 from the cluster (drain) to see if errors reduce. On it.
ops-bot: action created: #ticket-9813 — emergency-drain-node-17 assigned to trisha, severity=high
maya: quick check on logs while trisha drains — still seeing errors but throughput on node-18 is ramping. Could be noisy neighbor on node-17.
lucas: if drain helps, we'll roll back routing to primary model after 10m observation. Can someone run a smoke test endpoint `/v1/health/gen` with a 256-token prompt post-drain?
nate: I can automate smoke runs from eu-west canary — will post results in 5m.
devon: I see one model process on node-17 with repeated `cudaMalloc` failures — pushing OOM patterns. Looks like quantized kernel at higher batch sizes tripping allocation.	risha: node-17 drained. Removing from LB now.
ops-bot: node-17 state -> DRAINING -> DRAINED (15:21 PDT)
maya: errors falling to baseline. 5xx rate down ~80% in last 2m.
lucas: great. Nate, smoke test?
nate: smoke results: 20/20 OK, median latency down from 620ms -> 210ms. Posting histogram: `p50=210ms p95=430ms`
devon: re-enabling primary routing now. Will monitor for a few minutes.
ops-bot: routing policy updated: fallback disabled for eu-west at 15:27 PDT
trisha: created follow-up ticket #9814 for root cause (single-model OOM under burst). Assigning to eng-runtime group.
lucas: owners confirmed — trisha for infra mitigation, devon + maya for model behavior investigation, nate for canary automation. We'll reconvene if anything spikes again. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
maya: leaving the bridge, will update ticket with logs and eviction charts.
devon: staying on watch for 10m then off.
lucas: closing thread — keep channel updated if anything else crops up.
